The father hears the demand that she bring one hundred million yen alone by noon or the hostage will die. He knows that paying would require the daughter to come alone to a drop-off arranged by a stranger who cannot be trusted to honor the deal, exposing her to robbery or serious harm. So he decides the ransom should not be paid: he is willing to sacrifice his own safety rather than send his daughter alone into danger.
